name: Documentation problem
about: Report missing, contradictory, outdated, or hard-to-follow documentation
title: "docs: "
labels: documentation
assignees: ""
---

Do not disclose vulnerabilities or private data here. Follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for sensitive reports.

## Reader and task

Who is reading, and what are they trying to understand or complete?

## Location

Link the page and section, or name the missing entrypoint.

## Current result

What did the reader understand or do after following the current documentation? Quote only the minimum wording needed to identify the problem.

## Expected clarity

What should the reader be able to explain, decide, or complete without private guidance?

## Suggested change

Describe the smallest correction, example, reordering, or cross-link that would resolve the problem.

## Language and command parity

- [ ] I checked whether the English and Simplified Chinese companions share the same anchors, section order, and fenced command blocks.
- [ ] I identified any command whose behavior I verified and the platform or Host used.

## Evidence and limits

Provide a safe reproduction, screenshot, or reader observation when available. State what was not tested.
